rules.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
rules.sampleHtml: StudyPilot
rules.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size (170.5px by 20px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 20.4px instead of at least 24px.

rules.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
rules.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 2.07:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #5fb39a, surrounding text: #eceae4)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text

rules.help: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
rules.sampleHtml: <button type="submit" class="flex w-full items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-sunken disabled:opacity-70" aria-label="Open">
rules.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Text inside the element is not included in the accessible name

rules.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
rules.sampleHtml: 16
rules.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.47 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #f08a5d, font size: 7.5pt (10px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

rules.help: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
rules.sampleHtml: <ol class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto p-4" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Messages with Bruno Costa">
rules.failureSummary:
Fix all of the following:
  List element has direct children that are not allowed: div

incomplete.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

bestPractice.help: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
All page content should be contained by landmarks
Page should contain a level-one heading
Heading levels should only increase by one
Main landmark should not be contained in another landmark
Document should not have more than one main landmark
